gappers.catalyst: CoreWeave CEO Michael Intrator disclosed a sale of 300,000+ shares (~$27.3M); AI-infrastructure names under renewed selling pressure amid reports of short bets against AI favorites.
headlines: CoreWeave's CEO Dumps Over 300,000 Shares Worth $27.3 Million (Nasdaq)
CoreWeave GC Kristen McVeety Sells 2,100 Shares (Nasdaq)
Michael Burry Bought Beaten-Down Stocks And Shorted AI Favorites (Stocktwits)
gappers.catalyst_detail: Two insider Form 4 sales hit the tape: CEO Michael Intrator sold 300,000+ shares (~$27.3M) and General Counsel Kristen McVeety sold 2,100 shares. No new earnings or guidance event today — last report was Aug 11 and was strong (Q2 revenue $1.21B, adj. EBITDA margin 62%, $30.1B backlog, $4B OpenAI expansion deal on top of the existing $11.9B deal). Concurrently, AI-infrastructure/cloud names are under renewed sector-wide selling pressure amid recirculated reports that investor Michael Burry is shorting AI favorites.
gappers.why: Insider selling from the CEO reads as a negative signal even without new fundamental news, and it's landing on top of a broader risk-off rotation out of high-multiple AI/cloud infrastructure names (Burry-short headlines). No documented positive catalyst is driving the move — it's sentiment/overhang-driven selling, not a fundamental deterioration.
gappers.impact: Premarket volume (359K) is a small fraction of CRWV's 27.29M average daily volume, so this reads as thin premarket tape, not a volume-confirmed breakdown. Sector read-through is real: this is CRWV's second sub-6% single-day drop in the past ~7 weeks (also -5.7% on Jul 15), consistent with a stock in a broader multi-week AI-infra derating rather than a one-off headline spike.
gappers.horizon: SHORT_TERM — the CEO stock sale and Burry-short headlines are sentiment overhangs, not structural changes; backlog ($30.1B) and OpenAI contracts are unchanged, so absent a new fundamental catalyst this reads as noise likely to fade rather than a durable repricing.
gappers.opportunity_cost: N/A for a long entry — this is a gap DOWN with no documented positive catalyst, which fails the strategy's explicit 'Bottom-fish' guardrail (no long entry without a documented catalyst; drawdown alone is not a catalyst) and the Confluence rule (needs ≥2 indicators + ≥1 catalyst). Account currently has 0/6 open positions and 0/3 trades used this week, so there is no displacement question — this setup simply doesn't clear the entry bar as a long. Not a short candidate either; strategy is long-only stocks.
